description: This file implements SSL/TLS socket handling, including certificate management, OpenSSL initialization, and secure connection handling within the WPEFramework Crypto namespace.

classes.name: OpenSSL
classes.description: Helper class for initializing OpenSSL library functions, ensuring they are called once.

classes.name: SecureSocketPort::Certificate
classes.description: Represents an SSL certificate, providing methods to retrieve issuer, subject, validity period, hostname validation, and verification.

classes.name: SecureSocketPort::Handler
classes.description: Manages SSL/TLS connection lifecycle, including initialization, reading, writing, handshake validation, and connection state management.

methods.name: ASN1_ToTime
methods.description: Converts an ASN1_TIME structure to a Core::Time object.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Certificate::Issuer
methods.description: Returns the issuer name of the certificate.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Certificate::Subject
methods.description: Returns the subject name of the certificate.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Certificate::ValidFrom
methods.description: Returns the start of the certificate's validity period.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Certificate::ValidTill
methods.description: Returns the end of the certificate's validity period.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Certificate::ValidHostname
methods.description: Checks if the certificate is valid for the given hostname.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Handler::~Handler
methods.description: Destructor that frees SSL and context resources.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Handler::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes SSL context and SSL object, loads default verify paths.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Handler::Read
methods.description: Reads data from the SSL connection.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Handler::Write
methods.description: Writes data to the SSL connection.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Handler::Close
methods.description: Closes the SSL connection and frees resources.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Handler::ValidateHandShake
methods.description: Validates the SSL handshake, including certificate verification and hostname validation.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Handler::Update
methods.description: Performs SSL handshake steps and updates connection state.
